lines.text: No, wait. Hold that thought. I am rubbing something out.
I still think it looks incredible. Do not tell Master Voll. He already knows.
Repair first, he said. Then the arch. Six weeks of scaffolding I did not want to do.
A crack in a pier two valleys over. I heard. I am not going to look. I am going to look.
You hold things. I heard about the hold. How do you stand it?
